notes.title: Challenge Journey v1.2.1212 Release - Venture forth with your teammate now!
notes.content:
What's new:

[h1]Multiplayer Conversation System[/h1]
Your teammates will now join in on your interactions! Whether you're exploring unknown caves or uncovering the secrets of ancient ruins, your teammates will actively participate, bringing more surprises to your journey.

[h1]Long-Term Memory System[/h1]
Your adventure companions and every element in the game world will now have a "memory". They will remember previous interactions and conversations, and all interactions will shape your unique gaming experience.

[h1]Adventure Theme Update[/h1]
We have completely refreshed the event themes in the game with an "Adventure Theme". We've moved away from the previous humorous style to allow players to experience a more authentic sense of adventure.

[h1]Interaction Experience Enhancement[/h1]
We've optimized the dialogues with interactive items throughout the game world. Every detail and action will feel more realistic and vivid.

notes.title: Journey Mode Launched!
notes.content:
Brand New Mode Update: Challenger's Odyssey — Journey Mode!

Adventurers, prepare for an all-new 3D top-down RPG experience! The latest Journey Mode is now live, where travelers will traverse the Mushroom Village, exploring a brand-new journey filled with unknown opportunities and challenges. In this land of fantasy, exciting events and stories await you around every corner.

Winding your way through the nooks and crannies of Mushroom Village, you will experience an array of eye-catching adventure activities. Tread carefully on paths brimming with danger, and be wary of malicious creatures lurking in the shadows. Employ your clever wordsmithing (keyboard typing!) to participate in real-time generated events, acquiring items to fend off the monsters that impede your progress, and ensure you can safely go through Mushroom Village!

Embrace the challenges bravely, and uncover the mysteries of this unknown world. An adventure of courage and wit is about to begin—are you ready? Update now, and the legend of the adventurer begins here!
